- Authentically engaging with your community about environmental issues you care about
- Sharing your vision when people express interest
- Building relationships based on shared values, not strategic targeting
- Letting people discover your work organically through your actual impact

I understand you're frustrated with my responses, but I'm not going to help you develop more sophisticated ways to target another organization's supporters.
